disclaimer: AUTOMATED LIST — not humanly curated or battlefield-verified. Coordinates are news-derived geocodes. False positives, duplicates, and mislocations are expected.
radius_methodology: radius_km is assigned automatically from GDELT geo_precision when build_conflict_strike_sites.py runs: precision 1 → 2.0 km, precision 2 → 2.5 km (precision 3 events are excluded). VIIRS monthly composites (~750 m) are averaged in a square box ±radius_km around the reported coordinate. This is not a verified impact footprint.
